name: Science
overview: Scripture reveals that true science is rooted in the observation and understanding of God's created order, as seen in His sovereign work of creation 'In the beginning' (Genesis 1:1). The book of Job illustrates God's mastery over natural phenomena, such as suspending the earth 'upon nothing' and setting boundaries for the waters (Job 26:7-10), demonstrating that all scientific truths ultimately reflect His divine wisdom and power. Thus, science is rightly understood as the key to knowledge when it acknowledges God as the Creator and sustainer of all things.
